summary: Frontend-only QA of the AUTH + ONBOARDING presentation refactor on live prod (SAFE / read-only). Verified login regression E2E (email → Continue → password → signin → 2FA dialog → /dashboard with valid TOTP), auth shell visuals in both themes at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844, register purpose-picker advance, three simple auth screens, and the /get-started wizard structure. All primary flows work; all data-testids are present; no horizontal overflow at 390px; no functional/console errors attributable to the refactor.

critical_code_review_comments: Theme persistence uses two keys ('theme-mode-public' + 'theme-mode-public-v2'); setting only the legacy key is silently ignored (v2 wins). Not a bug for users (the header theme-toggle-button writes both) but worth documenting in test notes so future automation uses v2.
seed_data_creation: None — SAFE MODE, read-only against live prod PostgreSQL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth+onboarding presentation refactor verified. Header theme toggle is data-testid=theme-toggle-button (NOT the language trigger — that has data-testid=auth-lang-trigger). For dark mode via localStorage you MUST set BOTH 'theme-mode-public' and 'theme-mode-public-v2' to 'dark' before load (v2 supersedes). Register auto-skips picker if localStorage dyno_purpose_vertical/dyno_seo_attr exist — clear localStorage first. Under heavy Playwright load the preview hits Cloudflare 429 and JS chunks 429 → MIME errors; ignore.
